scopes.label: Core
scopes.desc: Embodied navigation is the paper's main subject (method, benchmark, dataset, simulator, survey or analysis).

scopes.label: Adjacent
scopes.desc: Navigation is a substantial but secondary part: EQA, mobile manipulation / rearrangement, embodied instruction following, general embodied agents or VLAs with a navigation evaluation, 3D grounding built for navigation.

scopes.label: Aerial (parked)
scopes.desc: UAV / drone / aerial vision-language navigation or tracking. Kept, but out of the first survey.

scopes.label: Out of scope
scopes.desc: Not embodied navigation: web/GUI/app navigation, autonomous driving, pure geometric motion planning / SLAM / LiDAR obstacle avoidance / legged locomotion with no goal semantics, 2D crowd simulation, manipulation-only, text-only, non-robotics uses of the word navigation.

tasks.label: Instruction VLN
tasks.desc: Follow fine-grained route instructions (R2R, RxR, R4R, VLN-CE, Touchdown-style).

tasks.label: Goal-oriented VLN
tasks.desc: High-level language goal / remote object grounding (REVERIE, SOON, 'find the X in the Y').

tasks.label: Dialog / Interactive
tasks.desc: Dialogue, question asking, ask-for-help or human-in-the-loop navigation (CVDN, HANNA, NDH).

tasks.label: ObjectNav
tasks.desc: Object-goal navigation to a category, incl. open-vocabulary / zero-shot ObjectNav (HM3D, MP3D, OVON).

tasks.label: Instance Nav
tasks.desc: Navigate to a specific object instance given an image or description (Instance-ImageNav, InstanceNav, text-goal).

tasks.label: PixelNav
tasks.desc: Pixel-goal navigation (goal given as a pixel in the current view, PixNav).

tasks.label: Multi-goal / Lifelong
tasks.desc: Sequential multi-object or multimodal lifelong navigation (MultiON, GOAT, GOAT-Bench).

tasks.label: Social / Tracking
tasks.desc: Human-aware navigation, human following, embodied visual tracking.

tasks.label: Exploration
tasks.desc: Active exploration, coverage, map building for embodied agents.

tasks.label: Embodied QA
tasks.desc: Navigate to answer questions (EQA, OpenEQA, HM-EQA).

tasks.label: Mobile Manipulation
tasks.desc: Navigation as part of mobile manipulation / rearrangement / OVMM.

tasks.label: Generalist Nav
tasks.desc: One model/agent across several navigation task families, or general-purpose navigation foundation model.

settings.label: Continuous sim
settings.desc: Continuous control in a 3D simulator (Habitat, AI2-THOR, Isaac, iGibson).

settings.label: Real robot
settings.desc: Deployed or evaluated on a physical robot.

paradigms.label: Task-specific learning
paradigms.desc: Policy trained for the task from scratch or on frozen small encoders via IL/RL: seq2seq, cross-modal attention, RL, learned modular mapping (SemExp), graph planners. Dominant 2017-2021.

paradigms.label: Large-scale pretraining
paradigms.desc: Transformer vision-language pretraining for navigation (PREVALENT, VLN-BERT, HAMT, DUET), large-scale data generation/augmentation (ScaleVLN), self-supervised visual pretraining (OVRL), cross-embodiment navigation foundation models without an LLM (GNM, ViNT, NoMaD).

paradigms.label: Foundation model fine-tuned
paradigms.desc: An LLM / VLM / video-LLM / VLA backbone whose weights are fine-tuned (SFT, RL, adapters) into the navigation policy or planner (NavGPT-2, NaVid, Uni-NaVid, NaVILA, StreamVLN).

paradigms.label: Zero-shot modular
paradigms.desc: No navigation-specific weight updates for the decision model. Frozen CLIP / detectors / LLM / VLM composed in a FIXED human-designed pipeline: value maps, frontiers, scene graphs, LLM-as-planner called once per step (CoW, ESC, VLFM, NavGPT, MapGPT, InstructNav, SG-Nav).

paradigms.label: Agentic
paradigms.desc: The LLM/VLM owns the control flow: chooses tools / skills / modes, self-reflects and replans, manages its own memory, or several agents collaborate (DiscussNav, multi-agent, tool-using nav agents). Agent HARNESSES are agentic too — systems whose contribution is the orchestration layer around the model (control loop, context / memory management, tools, verification) or that write / evolve code, skills, prompts or policies (self-evolving, agent-as-optimizer); give those the Harness trait as well. Fine-tuned agents still count here if the agent loop is the contribution.

paradigms.label: No method
paradigms.desc: Benchmark, dataset, simulator, survey or analysis with no new navigation method.

traits.desc: explicit metric or semantic map / value map
reinforcement learning (incl. RL fine-tuning of FMs)

agent harness / scaffold / self-evolving: the orchestration layer around the model is the contribution, or the agent writes / evolves code, skills, prompts or policies (always together with paradigm agentic)
